196 · Delete duplicate emails
uses.snippet:

uses.title: 1327 · Products with at least 100 February units
uses.snippet:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.unit) AS unit FROM Orders o
JOIN Products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2020-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2020-03-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING SUM(o.unit) >= 100;

uses.snippet:
SELECT m.title, b.rating FROM movies m

uses.title: Expressions and aliases
uses.snippet:
SELECT m.title, (b.domestic_sales + b.international_sales) / 1000000.0 AS sales_millions
FROM movies m JOIN boxoffice b ON m.id = b.movie_id;

uses.title: Expressions and aliases
uses.snippet:
SELECT m.title, b.rating * 10.0 AS rating_percent
FROM movies m JOIN boxoffice b ON m.id = b.movie_id;

uses.title: Logical query order
uses.snippet:
SELECT m.director, SUM(b.domestic_sales + b.international_sales) AS total_sales
FROM movies m JOIN boxoffice b ON m.id = b.movie_id GROUP BY m.director;
